DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall01: BAO: Stem, why did you ask to meet today? I remember you saying you'd be occupied.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall02: STEM: And I was, Leersi! But now, it's ready.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall03: LEERSI: I'd appreciate if you were clearer...
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall04: STEM: I've made a clue hunt! If you two solve it, you'll find my secret.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall05: LEERSI: A clue hunt? Why not just tell us?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall06: STEM: I do not want any adult finding out. Besides, it'll be fun! Trust me!
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall07: LEERSI: So what is the first hint?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall08: STEM: "When two after noon stretches the dial's shadow,"
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall09: STEM: "Go behind, away, until a small barrow."
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall10: BAO: You could have made it less obtuse, if you were kind.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall11: STEM: My kindness is in wanting to share my discoveries, Bao!
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall12: BAO: Believe me, Leersi: To understand Stem might be the greatest discovery a Nomai can make.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseWall13: STEM: Thank you for the compliment, friend.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseRecord01: ADENA: Is Leersi not the name of one of your ancestors, my love?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseRecord02: NEEM: Indeed it is! Of my great-great-grandmother, I believe.
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseRecord03: ADENA: It is so unusual to find undisturbed writing from so many generations ago. How do you feel?
DialogueDictionary.$SomeHouseRecord04: NEEM: I cannot deny it is strange, and I must admit I wish to see more of it. Hypothesis: Their clue hunt will prove the greatest source of my ancestor's writing. Would you indulge me in following it, my dear?
